profile.headline: Software Engineer @ JPMC
profile.summary: Hello! I’m Zaina, a software engineer who enjoys building reliable, data-driven backend systems and web services. My work has mainly involved designing and maintaining APIs, working with complex data models, and using AWS to support infrastructure and deployment. I like tackling problems behind the scenes and creating systems that are efficient, scalable, and easy to maintain. Along the way, I’ve also gained experience with web vulnerabilities and developed an interest in cybersecurity, AI, and front-end development. I’m always looking to learn something new and keep growing across different areas of software development!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Build and maintain backend services that handle metadata extraction and capture for various document types
- Develop APIs and application logic primarily using Java and Spring Boot, focusing on performance, scalability, and clean design
- Implement complex data models and structures that support both incoming requests and application responses, improving data flow and consistency across services
- Create optimized SQL scripts and views to simplify data retrieval, reduce query costs, and enhance endpoint efficiency
- Use Terraform and Spinnaker to configure AWS infrastructure and manage deployments across multiple environments
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to refine backend processes and increase overall system performance

positions.title: Academic Intern
positions.description: Developed the backend of a vulnerable web application for Capture-The-Flag style cybersecurity exercises, implementing a flagging system with Spring Boot and Java and using MariaDB to store flags and challenge data

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Developed SQL scripts in MariaDB to strengthen the security and reliability of a banking application’s database
- Created and implemented a Docker Compose setup to streamline deployment and testing of database updates
- Performed controlled vulnerability injections, such as SQL Injection, Cross-Site Scripting, and Insecure Direct Object References, to identify and demonstrate potential security risks
- Collaborated with developers to document findings and recommend mitigation strategies for discovered vulnerabilities

positions.title: Student EdTech Consultant
positions.description:
- Assisted staff with technical issues related to teaching applications such as Zoom, Canvas, and Adobe Acrobat
- Collaborated with fellow EdTech consultants to develop clear solutions and documentation for common staff questions
- Helped test and troubleshoot new educational tools to ensure smooth classroom integration

positions.title: Junior Developer
positions.description:
- Helped develop the functionality of two client websites using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
- Collaborated in weekly meetings to review client feedback and discuss requested website updates
- Worked with team members to plan and implement client changes efficiently and effectively
- Created wireframes with coworkers to guide design decisions and improve overall site functionality
- Presented wireframes and site features to mentors and teammates for feedback and improvement
positions.insights: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS), HTML and +5 skills

honors.title: Dean's List (Spring 2024)
honors.description:
In order to be eligible for the Dean’s List in Spring of 2024, students in the College of Science and Technology had to achieve a semester Grade Point Average of 3.89 or better.

That threshold was determined by the top 16% of all student GPAs in the College of Science and Technology over the previous five years.
honors.issuer: Issued by Miguel Mostafá Ph.D. Dean College of Science and Technology · May 2024
